history.content: Hi, my phone doesn’t have any signal at all. I can’t make calls or use the internet.

I can help you troubleshoot your signal issue. First, I need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the issue.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line is currently suspended, which is why you have no signal. The suspension is due to an overdue bill from your January billing cycle.

I have just sent you a payment request for the overdue amount of $65. Please check your payment requests and follow the instructions to complete the payment. Once the bill is paid, I can help you restore your service. Let me know once you have accepted and completed the payment.

history.content: My phone rebooted successfully, but I still have no signal and no 5G showing. What should I try next?

Let’s continue troubleshooting your signal issue. Please check your phone’s status bar for the following:

- Is Airplane Mode enabled?
- What is the signal strength indicator showing (e.g., no bars, 1 bar, etc.)?
- Does it show any network type (e.g., 5G, 4G, LTE)?

Could you please check your status bar and let me know what you see? This will help me determine the next steps.
I just checked my status bar and now it shows excellent signal, 5G, and data enabled. Everything looks back to normal.

That’s great news! Your service has been fully restored, and your phone is now showing excellent signal and 5G connectivity. You should be able to make calls, send texts, and use the internet as usual.

If you experience any further issues or have other questions, feel free to ask. Thank you for your patience!
